execution: Public source and published expected-output fixture only. No PostgreSQL or pgvector execution.
intentional_differences: Float64 Neumaier-compensated metric accumulations replace upstream float32 accumulations and architecture-dependent FMA. No bit-exact arithmetic compatibility is claimed; finite float32 inputs do not produce overflow or underflow in float64 metrics.
Cosine involving a zero norm returns ErrZeroNorm instead of upstream NaN; exact search aborts for an eligible zero-norm candidate.

Text parser accepts bounded ASCII decimal syntax only, rejecting hexadecimal, digit separators, quoted numbers, text over 1 MiB and a number over 128 bytes. Decimal underflow to signed float32 zero is accepted; rounding is direct with strconv.ParseFloat(token,32).
String formatting follows Go shortest float32 round trip, which may use different fixed/exponent thresholds from PostgreSQL.
BLOB format is project-specific versioned IEEE-754 float32 big-endian GSV format, not PostgreSQL wire/internal representation; float32 bits including signed zero are preserved.
Go zero Vector is invalid, not NULL. NullVector and Row.Null model NULL explicitly. New nil/empty slices are invalid.
